categories_thin: Architecture, surveying, environmental consulting, management consulting and general IT/software firms: almost nothing surfaced in Perth Amboy itself - the engineering query returned only two civil-engineering practices.

Doctors / independent physician offices: the town's medical care is dominated by large systems (Hackensack Meridian Raritan Bay, Consensus Health, MetroDoc) which are excluded, so only a handful of independent practices could be confirmed.
Independent insurance agencies: only five in-map results; carrier-branded agency pages (State Farm, Allstate, etc.) were excluded by rule and may hide more independent agencies.
Law firms: the map view returned five firms; Martindale/Avvo entries supply a few more but some may have moved or merged, so the count is uncertain.
Waxing, threading, tanning and standalone day spas: only a few appear; most may be bundled inside the salons already listed.
caveats: Google Maps served a lite view with about five results per query and disabled pagination, so map-derived categories are top-ranked rather than exhaustive.

Yellow Pages, Superpages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, Cylex, AllPages, LocalityBiz and Nicelocal all returned HTTP 403 to this environment; OpenStreetMap Overpass endpoints were unreachable. Some of those sites' listings reached me only as search-result snippets, which are noted in the entries.
Many personal-care entries come from a single directory (BestProsInTown, which mirrors map data) with no phone number, so their active_evidence is 'directory only' - triage should confirm each.

Perth Amboy addresses appear without a town on map listings; entries clearly located outside town (Woodbridge, Fords, Metuchen, Old Bridge, Staten Island) were dropped, and borderline ones are flagged in notes.

Excluded by rule and noted here: Raritan Bay Medical Center and Hackensack Meridian outpatient rehab, Consensus Health Primary Care, MetroDoc Urgent Care (hospital / large system / regional chain), Middlesex County's George J. Otlowski mental-health center (government), Keller Williams By The Bay (franchise office), PureGym (chain, opening 2027), Raritan Bay Area YMCA (nonprofit association), Catholic Charities Metuchen immigration services (charity), Gonzalez & Associates Inc. at 786 King Georges Rd (Fords, outside town), The Club at Woodbridge, Remedi Day Spa (Staten Island).
data_gaps: Phone numbers are Unknown for most salon, barber and nail entries because the source directory does not publish them and individual listing pages were not opened (cost control).
Website URLs are blank where no link was seen on a listing; they were never guessed. A few businesses (Bose Tax, Perusa, Vas Law, Dr. Chavarria) have a website but no verified street address.
Two map-discovered businesses were deliberately dropped for privacy: DigiMark Direct (apartment address) and The Grooms Agency (residential street address). Confirm a business address before adding.
ZIP-code verification of a few addresses (e.g. 5109 Klimek Pl, 554 Harbortown Blvd, 540 Bordentown Ave) not completed; all appeared as Perth Amboy listings.
No official municipal or chamber business directory exists online for Perth Amboy, so no authoritative list could be used as a completeness baseline.
Searches for staffing and title firms relied on directory snippets surfaced by web search; the underlying Yellow Pages pages themselves were blocked, so those entries need verification.
